step_a_router.prompt: Tactile Tabletop HUD: Bottom Hand Arc, 3D Column Header Dice, Top Boss Commander, Recessed Brass Sockets, and Collapsible Dev Drawer

contract.state: state.{grid, hand, aiPool, colDice, nudgesLeft, rerollsLeft, trauma, hitStopActive}

report.suite: CARDFRONT 3D Tabletop, 16 Unique Telegraphs & 3:4 Mastered Portrait E2E Playtest (osascript)

checks.rule: A card existing in two zones at once -> duplication/loss bugs. Enforce 'exactly one zone'; move = remove-then-add, and assert no card appears twice.
checks.remediation: Keep single-zone partition invariant across state.hand, state.aiPool, and state.grid.

checks.rule: Off-by-one in the shuffle's random index -> some orders never occur (a biased deck). Include upper bound i in Fisher-Yates.
checks.remediation: Use inclusive upper bound (i + 1) in Fisher-Yates shuffle.

checks.rule: Card data — id, name, cost, type, text, and an effect spec (data, not code).
checks.remediation: Ensure all 16 cards in ALL_CARDS define structured NESW and telegraph data fields.

checks.rule: Turn structure as a phase machine — Fixed phases keep timing windows (triggers, priority) unambiguous.
checks.remediation: Store the timer ID from `state.bossTurnTimer = setTimeout(executeBossTurn, 650)` at line 1754 and call `clearTimeout(state.bossTurnTimer)` inside `startStage(idx)` at line 1546 so Reset/Stage-Select never leaks a stale boss turn onto the new board (Bug R01).

checks.rule: Targeting state leaks -> a cancelled play leaves the board mid-targeting. Make play atomic: validate cost + targets first, then commit.
checks.remediation: Call `detachDragListeners(); teardownDrag();` inside `startStage(idx)` at line 1546, and re-validate `state.isPlayerTurn && srcCell.owner === 'player'` inside `onDragPointerUp()` at line 2366 before committing a drop or Tactical Slide (Bugs R03, R04).

checks.rule: Effect resolution — apply a card's effects in a defined order; handle targets and triggers consistently across all board units.
checks.remediation: Fix `recalcBoardStats()` at line 1614 so captured cards preserve their base/stage `aiBonus` and AI-owned cards in boosted columns also recalculate cleanly when column dice change (Bug R07).

checks.rule: Unseeded shuffle in a game that needs replays/undo -> can't reproduce. Use a seeded RNG instance (not the engine's global one).
checks.remediation: Replace raw `Math.random()` in `shuffle()`, `rerollAllDice()`, and `executeBossTurn()` with a deterministic seeded PRNG (`mulberry32(state.seed)`) synced with URL `?seed=`.

checks.rule: Store trauma 0..1; shake = trauma^2 so small hits barely move, big hits punch. Smooth pseudo-random via sampled noise/sin, NOT rand each frame.
checks.remediation: Drive screen shake from decaying quadratic `trauma * trauma` and smooth sine waves.

checks.rule: Hit-stop with WaitForSecondsRealtime ignores Time.timeScale, so the timer still elapses. Let only the newest call restore it.
checks.remediation: Use WaitForSecondsRealtime and an incrementing hit-stop token in Unity C#.

checks.rule: (1) Exaggerate briefly and return to rest; (2) scale juice to event importance — a routine placement is not a multi-card capture.
checks.remediation: Scale trauma with capture count and reserve 80ms hit-stop for captures.

checks.rule: Over-juicing routine actions causes nausea and hides real impacts. Scale to importance; add a 'reduce screen shake'/'reduce flashing' accessibility option.
checks.remediation: Respect `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` and provide a UI toggle to suppress `addTrauma()` and brightness-flash hit-stop filters.

checks.rule: Pick a layout model: anchors + containers, never absolute pixels. Scale to fit with zero viewport clipping.
checks.remediation: Use CSS Grid containers and `clamp()` viewport-relative sizing so 1408x800 and 1280x800 never overflow.

checks.rule: Make every screen keyboard/gamepad navigable. Set an initial focused control per screen, define focus order/neighbors.
checks.remediation: Initialize `state.focusedSlotIndex = 4` (center tile) and support keyboard navigation.

checks.rule: Model screens as a stack. Push (pause/modal over game), pop (resume/reset), with input + visibility handed to the top screen.
checks.remediation: In `startStage(idx)` at line 1546, explicitly pop/hide `#result-modal` (`document.getElementById('result-modal').style.display = 'none'`), auto-focus the primary modal button on open, and hide/disable `Next Stage ▶` when `win === false` (Bugs R08, R09).

checks.rule: Tiny fixed font sizes are unreadable on a TV-at-distance or small phone. Scale text with the UI (Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101 floor).
checks.remediation: Raise minimum UI badge/pill typography from `9.5px`/`10px` to `clamp(12px, 1.1vw, 14px)` and add non-color owner icons alongside blue/red borders for deuteranopia accessibility.

checks.rule: Technical fit: exact size/frame count, usable alpha, stable anchors/pivots, correct color space/filtering, no clipped content.
checks.remediation: Maintain 600x800 (3:4 portrait) mastered card art across all 16 hero and mech units.

checks.rule: UI art or icons: Keep text and interaction code-native; prefer SVG/vector for simple geometric symbols.
checks.remediation: Keep all 16 card telegraph overlays as crisp inline SVG vector animations.

checks.rule: Define the class deriving from ScriptableObject and tag it with [CreateAssetMenu]; keep mutable runtime state in [NonSerialized] fields reset in OnEnable.
checks.remediation: Derive shared variable/card config classes from ScriptableObject with [CreateAssetMenu] and [NonSerialized] runtime state.

checks.rule: Disabled Domain Reload skips your OnEnable reset — also reset on EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged or [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)].
checks.remediation: Subscribe `EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged` inside `#if UNITY_EDITOR` on `ScriptableObjectDomainReloadGuard` so fast Play Mode entry without Domain Reload still resets `RuntimeValue`.

checks.rule: Define actions, not raw keys; guard global key handlers when native form/select controls hold focus and expose all gameplay actions to keyboard.
checks.remediation: In `handleHarnessKeyDown(e)` at line 1410, ignore key events when `['SELECT','BUTTON','INPUT'].includes(e.target.tagName)` (Bug R10) and bind keys (e.g. `q`/`e`/`z` or `Alt+1..3`) to `nudgeColDie(0..2)`.

checks.rule: Lay out buses, not per-sound volume (Master <- {Music, SFX, UI}) and operate in decibels with SFX pitch variation.
checks.remediation: Route `playTone()` through a persistent `masterGain` / `sfxBus` GainNode with dB-to-linear conversion (`Math.pow(10, db / 20)`), subtle pitch jitter (`±0.5` semitones), and a header Mute button.

checks.rule: Define a versioned schema (`version` integer) and persist player progress/settings across sessions.
checks.remediation: Persist unlocked/cleared stages, best stage scores, camera preset, and audio mute state to `localStorage` under a versioned JSON schema (`{ version: 1, clearedStages: [...], bestScores: {...} }`).

checks.rule: Pick the decision model by complexity: utility scoring evaluates candidate options across offensive capture and positional defense rather than random tie-breaking.
checks.remediation: Upgrade `executeBossTurn()` at line 1773 from single-card `aiPool.pop()` + random tie-break (`f > bestCount`) to a deterministic utility scorer that weights immediate captures, corner control, and unexposed weak edges (Bug R02).

checks.rule: Define the target and reproduce: 60 FPS = 16.67 ms/frame budget; zero long tasks (>50ms) during pointer drag and hover sweeps.
checks.remediation: Keep `renderAll()` under 1 ms and freeze board parallax during active pointer drag so 60 Hz frame pacing holds at `p95 <= 16.8ms`.

checks.rule: Dedicated Boss AI decision entrypoint exists in the Web playable runtime
checks.remediation: Keep dedicated Boss turn execution entrypoint.

checks.rule: Boss AI should evaluate all candidate cards in state.aiPool rather than blindly popping the last card before scoring
checks.remediation: Evaluate all candidate (cardId, slot) pairs in state.aiPool using selectBossUtilityAction() in boss_ai_utility.js.

checks.rule: Boss AI should score multi-factor normalized 0..1 response curves (flips, edge exposure, topology, boosted column denial, 1-ply counter-flip resistance) with IAUS compensation
checks.remediation: Integrate boss_ai_utility.js (5 normalized response curves + IAUS compensation + 1-ply lookahead).

checks.rule: Utility AI prototype implements normalized response curves and IAUS makeup compensation (Curves.compensate) in boss_ai_utility.js
checks.remediation: None required; IAUS makeup compensation verified in boss_ai_utility.js:54-59.

checks.rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 2.0x relative win-rate uplift over the current greedy Boss AI against a Greedy Player across 2,000 simulated matches
checks.remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 15.95% overall win rate vs 6.65% baseline (2.40x uplift across 2,000 matches).

checks.rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 25% win rate on Stage 4 (Apex Neural Core) against a Greedy Player
checks.remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 30.4% win rate on Stage 4 (up from 13.6% baseline) against a Greedy Player.

checks.rule: Utility AI Grandmaster tier achieves >= 60% overall win rate against a Random Player across 2,000 matches
checks.remediation: Grandmaster Utility AI achieves 65.0% overall win rate (85.6% on Stage 4) vs Random Player.

checks.rule: Difficulty tiers (Apprentice, Tactician, Grandmaster) scale monotonically in Boss win rate
checks.remediation: All 3 difficulty tiers (Apprentice 3.5%, Tactician 10.9%, Grandmaster 15.95%) scale monotonically.

checks.rule: Web playable must persist campaign progress (stageIdx, Wins, Losses) to localStorage across page reloads
checks.remediation: Persist stageIdx, Wins, Losses, and unlocked cards to localStorage with a versioned JSON schema.

checks.rule: Unity EchoGhostSnapshot save payload must include an explicit integer schema version field (`public int version = 1;`) from day one
checks.remediation: Add `public int version = 1;` to EchoGhostSnapshot and a sequential migration function `Migrate(raw)`.

checks.rule: Unity EchoGhostPvPManager implements HMAC-SHA256 receipt signing (`HMACSHA256`) for snapshot integrity verification
checks.remediation: Keep HMAC-SHA256 receipt generation for EchoGhostSnapshot integrity checks.

checks.rule: Authoritative PvP HMAC secret key must not be hardcoded in client source (`DefaultReceiptSecret`)
checks.remediation: Move authoritative PvP receipt verification secret to server environment variables; treat client checksum as non-authoritative corruption detection.

checks.rule: Save writes must use atomic temp-file replacement (`.tmp` -> `.bak` -> target) to prevent half-written corrupt saves
checks.remediation: Write snapshot JSON to `.tmp`, flush to disk, rotate existing save to `.bak`, and atomically rename to target path.

checks.rule: Card stats and stage configurations are externalized into top-level declarative data tables (`ALL_CARDS` and `STAGES`)
checks.remediation: None required; ALL_CARDS (16) and STAGES (4) are cleanly externalized in declarative tables.

checks.rule: Production shippable HTML should not embed automated test harnesses (`runVisualAutomatedPlaytest` / `runDragDropTest`) inline
checks.remediation: Extract automated test harnesses into external Playwright test scripts before shipping.

checks.rule: itch.io HTML5 zip root must contain an entry file named `index.html`
checks.remediation: Output build entry file as `index.html` at the root of the itch.io HTML5 zip archive.

checks.rule: itch.io HTML5 builds must not use parent-directory asset traversal (`../GeneratedArt/`) that escapes the zip root
checks.remediation: Copy GeneratedArt/ inside the web distribution root and rewrite paths to `./GeneratedArt/...`.

checks.rule: SteamPipe `app_build_*.vdf` and `depot_build_*.vdf` manifests with debug symbol exclusions (`*.pdb`, `*DoNotShip*`) must exist before Steam release
checks.remediation: Create SteamPipe `app_build_<appid>.vdf` and `depot_build_<depotid>.vdf` manifests with FileExclusion rules for `*.pdb`, `*.burst.debug*`, and `*DoNotShip*`.

checks.rule: Lock the technical frame: all 16 mastered card portraits must be exact 600x800 PNGs with zero raster problems
Lock the technical frame: all 4 stage background textures must be exact 1024x768 PNGs with zero raster problems
Validate in context: all rendered .slot-art images in the live DOM must complete loading at 600x800 natural dimensions
Cohesion: card RMS luminance contrast coefficient of variation (CV) across the 16-card family must stay <= 0.12
Cohesion: card ink line-weight coefficient of variation (CV) across the 16-card family must stay <= 0.12
Cohesion: zero cards in the 16-card family should have |z| >= 2.0 style outlier flags on saturation, value, contrast, edge density, line weight, or noise
Color role separation: blue-ally vs red-enemy hue classifier accuracy across the 16 cards must be >= 0.80
Color role separation: Cohen's d for (blue_share - red_share) between Hero and Enemy card families must be >= 1.0
Framing: all 16 cards must keep subject center-of-mass Y <= 0.62 so focal subjects do not collide with the bottom name ribbon
Backgrounds and parallax: preserve a low-contrast playfield behind cards (raw center RMS contrast <= 0.20 across all 4 stage backgrounds)
Backgrounds and card family cohesion: stage background style distance to the card family centroid should stay <= 1.5 sigma
Name the visual system using concrete visual properties; do not substitute a living artist's name in prompts or filenames
UI art and icons: keep numbers, labels, and geometric symbols code-native SVG/HTML rather than baked raster text
Sovereign Style Variants and High-Contrast Competitive Silhouette Lock must guarantee 0.00% P2W combat stat modification
Single-Zone Invariant: every active card UID lives in at most one zone (hand, board, aiPool) with zero duplicates
Shuffle fairness: Fisher-Yates shuffle must use inclusive upper bound (i + 1) to avoid off-by-one permutation bias
Seeded RNG: shuffle and dice rolls must use a seeded PRNG instance rather than unseeded global Math.random() so runs are replayable
Card data completeness: all 16 cards in ALL_CARDS must define id, name, 4-element nesw array, art path, and telegraph spec
Atomic play commit: playing a card removes it from state.hand, places it on state.grid, and flips captured neighbors in one transaction
Unity C# 3x3 capture evaluation must compare against neighbor's effective boosted directional stats, not raw unboosted CardData.dir_*
Responsive layout at 1280x800: right-hand Boss & Dice side-box must stay inside the 1280px viewport even after hovering a board slot
CSS Grid min-width guard: .center-zone must declare min-width: 0 so nowrap telegraph text cannot blow out the 1fr column
Responsive aspect-ratio policy: WebPlayable CSS should include @media breakpoints so narrow/mobile viewports do not clip the board off-screen
Safe-area inset: WebPlayable CSS should respect env(safe-area-inset-*) for notched displays
Typography legibility floor: minimum computed font-size across visible UI text should be >= 12px (and >= 18px for primary HUD per XAG 101)
Keyboard focus navigation: pressing keys 1..5 selects the corresponding Hero card in state.hand
Keyboard focus highlight: moving state.focusedSlotIndex via Arrow keys must apply a dedicated visible focus class on the focused .board-slot even when the mouse is elsewhere
Modal focus management: opening #result-modal should focus its primary action button and support Escape/Enter dismissal
Actions over raw keys: input handling should map physical inputs through a named action binding table rather than inline e.key string checks
Physical key bindings: keyboard WASD navigation should inspect e.code (KeyW/KeyA/KeyS/KeyD) so AZERTY/Dvorak layouts preserve spatial direction
Discrete edge vs held key repeat: keydown handler for discrete actions (deploy, reroll, pulse) must ignore key auto-repeat (!e.repeat)
Multi-device gamepad support: poll navigator.getGamepads() or support gamepad D-pad/face buttons alongside keyboard and pointer
Pointer drag-and-drop hysteresis & Escape cancel: drag engine must enforce a movement threshold (>= 4px) before starting drag and cancel cleanly on Escape/blur
ScriptableObject runtime state must use [NonSerialized] fields reset in OnEnable so Play-mode mutations do not persist to disk
Disabled Domain Reload safety: ScriptableObject runtime variables must also reset on EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged or SubsystemRegistration
Authoring config as ScriptableObject assets: SovereignStyleVariantDescriptor table should live in ScriptableObject assets rather than a hardcoded static array
Quadratic trauma shake: screen shake amplitude must equal trauma * trauma so small hits are subtle and multi-captures punch
Smooth sampled sine/noise shake: camera shake must use continuous trigonometric/noise functions rather than per-frame Math.random() static
Hit-stop real-time recovery: triggerHitStop(80) must activate immediately and clear after ~80ms wall-clock time
Unity hit-stop must use WaitForSecondsRealtime so low Time.timeScale never stalls recovery
Overlapping hit-stops in WebPlayable must guard timer restore with a sequence ID so an earlier hit-stop cannot cut a newer one short
Consistent importance tiers: Boss captures in executeBossTurn and Tactical Slide captures should also trigger proportional trauma/feedback
checks.expect: >=3 call sites (hand deploy, slide capture, boss capture)

checks.rule: Accessibility option: provide a Reduce Screen Shake / prefers-reduced-motion check before applying trauma shake and brightness flash
Bus routing: WebAudio synthesis should route through a dedicated GainNode bus and DynamicsCompressorNode limiter rather than directly to actx.destination
Unity AudioSource routing: procedural audio sources must assign an AudioMixerGroup rather than leaving outputAudioMixerGroup null
SFX variation: repeated UI/card sound effects should apply small random pitch/volume offsets to avoid robotic repetition
Escalating combo audio: Unity procedural audio director scales capture fanfare arpeggio notes with captured card count (1..4)
3D board camera presets: setBoardCamera must update --board-tilt-x, --board-tilt-z, and rotateX/rotateZ on #board-3d-slab
Frame-rate-independent smoothing: dragTick ghost follow and board parallax should use dt-scaled exponential decay 1 - Math.exp(-rate * dt) instead of fixed per-frame lerp constants
Camera selector DOM ID consistency: runVisualAutomatedPlaytest must reference the existing #camera-select element rather than a non-existent #cam-select ID
checks.expect: 0 matches (element ID is camera-select at line 863)

checks.rule: Additive shake composition: camera shake offset on #arena-viewport is separated from 3D camera rotation on #board-3d-slab so follow and shake never fight
Frame-time budget: p95 frame time across 60 rAF frames under active trauma shake and SVG animations must stay <= 20.0 ms (60 FPS target = 16.67 ms)
DOM node pooling vs innerHTML thrash: renderAll() should update existing slot/card DOM nodes in place rather than allocating >100 new DOM nodes across 20 hover renders
Unity object pooling: SynapsePool<T> and SwapBuffer<T> provide zero-allocation object reuse for AI lookahead and resolve queues
Avoid LINQ in hot simulation/AI paths: Unity AI and game-logic scripts should not import System.Linq
Stop idle rAF loops: startGameFeelTraumaLoop should sleep when state.trauma === 0 rather than scheduling requestAnimationFrame 60 times/sec unconditionally
